about: English Bible versions found in the sources catalogued by docs/integrations/bible-content-sources-and-external-datasets.md (EXTRAS-SRC). Research data, not an approved B5 matrix: only versions whose "redistribution" is public-domain or open may be stored or considered for packs, and each still needs B5 review before any pack build.

sourcesChecked.API.Bible / Crossway ESV: keyed APIs — copyrighted versions named in EXTRAS-SRC §1.1, listed without access

sourcesNotFound.beandog/bible-sqlite: GitHub 404 on 2026-11-28; the user beandog has no Bible repositories.
sourcesNotFound.YouVersion Platform: Version list requires a developer key; not queried.
